a: ‘An-nazi‘at’: the angels who extract the souls of the disbelievers from their bodies.
With deep plunging, severity, and pain in extracting, as they pull them out from the farthest reaches of the bodies.
‘An-nashitat’: the angels who draw out the souls of the believers gently; or the horses of warriors that set out briskly from land to land.
‘As-sabihat’: the angels who descend swiftly to what they are commanded, gliding in the air as a diver swims in water; or the running horses, stars, or ships.
A swift descent, or running, or setting forth.
‘As-sabiqat’: the angels who hasten and race to carry out Allah’s command, or race with the souls to their abode, Fire or Paradise.

‘Those who arrange affairs’: the angels who descend with the arrangement commanded by Allah, glorified is He, such as clarifying the lawful and unlawful, the movement of winds, the descent of rains, and so on.
What they are commanded by Allah, glorified is He.
What is meant is the Day of Resurrection.

The event that follows what preceded it; what is meant is the second blowing in the Horn, the blowing of resurrection.

Musa is a messenger whom Allah the Exalted sent to Pharaoh and his people, and supported with two miracles: one of them is the staff that swallowed the serpents; the other was his hand, which he would put into his bosom and it would come out white without any blemish. Musa called to the oneness of Allah, so Pharaoh fought him and gathered the sorcerers against him to plot against him, but he defeated them by the permission of Allah the Exalted. Then Allah commanded him to leave Egypt with those who followed him, and Pharaoh pursued him with a great army; and when his followers thought they would be overtaken, Allah commanded him to strike the sea with his staff, so that it would be his salvation and the destruction of Pharaoh, whom Allah made a lesson for others.
An adverb that indicates, in most cases, past time.
‘The sacred valley’: a valley in Sinai at the foot of Mount Tur; in it Allah spoke to Musa directly.
‘The sacred valley’: a valley in Sinai at the foot of Mount Tur; in it Allah spoke to Musa directly.
